Can the software integrate with our existing calendars and HR systems?
Talview's interview scheduling software replaces back-and-forth scheduling emails with automated booking, calendar integration (Google Calendar, Outlook, and MS Teams), and automated reminders to interviewers and candidates. This reduces last-minute cancellations and no-shows and cuts the manual coordination work for recruiters.
Can it handle bulk interview scheduling for large hiring drives?
Yes. The platform supports recurring, high-volume hiring drives with many concurrent interviews, coordinated automatically across candidates and interviewers, built for mass hiring rounds, not just one-off interviews.
How does it improve the candidate experience?
Candidates book their own slot against real interviewer availability, receive automated reminders (including a pre-join notification 10 minutes before the interview), and can reschedule without emailing a recruiter reducing uncertainty and last-minute confusion for candidates.
How is interview scheduling data kept private and secure?
Interview scheduling data is handled under Talview's platform-wide security and privacy controls, including SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance.
Run one exam through it. Then decide.
One exam. One requisition. Thirty to sixty days. See it on your own sessions before you commit to anything larger.

What Is a Virtual Interview Room / Live Interview Room Platform?
A virtual interview room, sometimes called an interview space, video interview room, or online interview platform, is a secure, browser-based meeting room built specifically for hiring, rather than a general video-call tool repurposed for interviews. Unlike a generic video conferencing link, every interview room here comes with candidate verification, structured evaluation tools, and recording built in.
